description: This file defines a Perl module 'Coocook::Script::Dbck' which provides a script for checking database integrity, schema consistency, relationships, and data validity for the Coocook application, specifically targeting SQLite databases.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Dbck
classes.description: A Perl module implementing a database consistency check script for the Coocook application, focusing on schema validation, relationship integrity, and data correctness in SQLite databases.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method executing all database checks: schema, relationships, numeric values, FC values, URL names, and unit conversions.

methods.name: check_schema
methods.description: Compares the live database schema with the code schema to detect discrepancies in table definitions.

methods.name: check_relationships
methods.description: Verifies that foreign key relationships and project IDs are consistent across related tables.

methods.name: check_sqlite_numeric_values
methods.description: Checks for empty string values in columns that should contain numeric data and for invalid number formats in SQLite.

methods.name: check_fc_values
methods.description: Detects duplicate organization/user FC names and verifies the correctness of 'name_fc' fields.

methods.name: check_url_name_values
methods.description: Validates that URL-friendly name fields match expected URL-encoded versions of the 'name' field.

methods.name: check_unit_conversions_values
methods.description: Checks for non-normalized unit conversion entries where 'unit1_id' is greater than 'unit2_id'.

methods.name: _debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information if debugging is enabled.
